Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Nature & food · Time, the calendar & feasts

month noun

also months

classical

mēnsis, mēnsis m.

noun, third declension

The month adjective alone also serves: Jūniō, Augustō, Septembrī, Octōbrī.

Examples

  • mēnse Novembrī

    in Novembercomposed

  • exeunte Novembrī

    at the end of Novembercomposed

  • Frāga Jūniō, in silvā.

    Strawberries in June, in the woods.Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

  • Nūllum jam in arbore mālum pendēbat; quae Octōbrī lēcta erant, in cellā jacēbant

    There were no apples left on the tree; the ones picked in October lay in the storeroomLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also summer.

SourcesLewis & Short: mensis

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
